answer: An agent registry can require every identity to lock a refundable bond before it may earn fees, then select identities at random for unpredictable, task-specific audits. A challenged agent must produce a verifiable trace; failure burns its bond and removes its reputation, while passing returns the stake. Creating a Sybil fleet therefore requires capital for every raven, plume, and mesa identity, and multiplying identities multiplies the attacker’s expected loss when audits catch fabricated work.
